'''Aral tukor Viest''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Lorrdian/Legends|Lorrdian]] who lived as a [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] flightmaster during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Viest was a former [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] and extremely sadistic; frequently making business associates partake in a specially designed game with a high risk of [[Death/Legends|death]] in order to earn her approval or mercy. When Viest captured [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] came to rescue him, using an insane mining droid to smash through Viest's control center. Just as Viest killed [[Caline Metara]], two blaster shots from [[Sian Tesar]] and [[Alia Terae]] killed her at once.
